keys.swarm.aura_starfall_desc: Shooting stars streak diagonally across the screen, hitting all they cross.
keys.swarm.aura_starfall_ten: Comet: one comet sweeps the whole screen.
keys.swarm.aura_gravity_well_desc: An orb is placed far ahead: it pulls monsters into it, then implodes. Bosses cannot be pulled.
keys.swarm.aura_gravity_well_up: A stronger pull and a bigger implosion.
keys.swarm.aura_gravity_well_ten: Event Horizon: a black hole drifts across the field.
